content_data.project_description: Build a distributed microservices architecture to detect and prevent fraudulent transactions in real-time across multiple payment channels. System will leverage machine learning models and event-driven processing to reduce fraud losses while minimizing false positives.
content_data.timeline: 14 months with Phase 1: Architecture & Core Services (months 1-5), Phase 2: ML Integration & Testing (months 6-10), Phase 3: Production Rollout & Optimization (months 11-14)
objectives: Achieve sub-200ms transaction processing latency for real-time fraud scoring
Design horizontally scalable architecture supporting 50,000+ transactions per second
deliverables: Automated test suite with 85%+ code coverage
Microservices architecture documentation and technical design specifications
Performance benchmarking report and capacity planning recommendations
Machine learning model integration framework with A/B testing capability
content_data.risk_assessment: Medium-high risk due to complex distributed system requirements and strict latency constraints. Primary concerns include third-party data provider integration dependencies, potential performance bottlenecks under peak load, and coordination across multiple engineering teams.
